quotes.text: A friend gave me this candle some time ago as a gift, not aware that she would be introducing me to my favorite candle of all time. As soon as I opened it, I wept…the scent (sage and tobacco) reminded me of my father who had recently passed away. As soon as that candle was finished, I had to buy another one. I burn it all the time, but especially at the holidays. Thank you for making this candle!
quotes.name: Lisa R.
